create_Qwen2ForRewardModel: create a Qwen2 reward model for scalar scoring with a single output label using VllmConfig
create_Qwen2ForProcessRewardModel: create a Qwen2 process reward model for token-level scoring with two output labels using VllmConfig
build_Qwen2RewardBaseModel: build a Qwen2 reward base model with a linear scoring head and pooling support for LoRA and pipeline parallelism
run_forward_inference: run forward inference on a Qwen2 reward model to compute reward logits from input_ids and positions
load_weights_Qwen2RM: load HuggingFace-compatible weights into a Qwen2 reward model using AutoWeightsLoader
